purpose: Mask-stage constraints only; detailed breast morphology remains in rules.json and is handed to image generation.

constraints.mask_statement: Only the declared source fine IDs may change to the declared target fine ID; DCIS, angioinvasion, normal epithelium, vessel, immune, necrosis, and every other unrequested label remain pixel-identical.
generation_handoff: Render the retained/new tumor subtype without changing protected fine-label regions.
known_limitations: A coarse profile without DCIS or angioinvasion IDs cannot enforce subtype preservation beyond its available labels.

constraints.mask_statement: When ducts, lobules, lumina, or vessels are encoded in a native or auxiliary structure map, rasterize them as prohibited regions and reject any overlap; when they are visible only on H&E, do not claim deterministic mask protection and abstain if the interface cannot avoid them.
generation_handoff: Preserve duct/lobule lumina and vessel walls visually; mask protection alone does not create their microscopic architecture.
known_limitations: Most semantic profiles do not encode myoepithelial layers, basement membrane, or gland lumina explicitly.

constraints.mask_statement: Every changed component must start from one selected existing source-to-target component interface and remain inside its allowed band; spread area along the interface before increasing depth.
generation_handoff: Match the selected local invasive growth pattern in the generated H&E.
known_limitations: Geometric naturalness does not prove histologic subtype compatibility.

constraints.mask_statement: Do not create islands, split a source component, merge target components, or add/fill source/target holes during a burden edit.
known_limitations: Dedicated topology-changing primitives are outside v1.
